upantika.p: [Upa+antika] (ti) CL=7 [Antikabhāvaṃ upagataṃ upantikaṃ. Dhāna, ṭī. 706.(upāntika-saṃ)] Being close. Close. Near.
a: အန္တိကဘာဝံ ဥပဂတံ ဥပန္တိကံ။ ဓာန်၊ ဋီ။ ၇ဝ၆။(ဥပါန္တိက-သံ)] နီးကပ်သည်၊ နီးကပ်သော၊ အနီး။

H: upantika：a．[upa-antika] 近的．acc．upantikaṃ adv．在附近．loc．upantike 在附近．
S: upantika：a．[upa-antika] 近き．acc．upantikaṃ adv．近くに．loc．upantike 近くに．

upantika：ဥပန္တိ-က （တိ）
အနီး၌ ဖြစ်သည်။ နီးကပ်သည်။
ဥပန္တိကံ၊ အနီး၌။
DOP: upantika n. [ S. upāntika], vicinity, neighbourhood ; — acc. ~aṃ, adv. , near to, towards, to the neighbourhood (of) ; Abh 706; Ja V 58, 24* (gaccha Vidhurassa ~aṃ); VI 425, 3* (laddho ca me āvasatho sāḷikāya ~aṃ); — abl. ~ā, adv. , from, from the neighbourhood (of) ; Ja VI 418, 12* (tato ca so apakkamma Vedehassa ~ā); — loc. ~e, adv. , near, in the neighbourhood (of) ; Pv 21:15 (āvesanaṃ ca me āsi Asayhassa ~e); Ap 146, 25 (cullāsītisahassāni yakkhā mayhaṃ ~e upaṭṭhahanti sakkaccaṃ); — see also upānta.
CPD: upantika , n. [ sa. upāntika], vicinity, proximity; acc. abl. and loc. used as postpositions; Abh 706; — Vidhurassa ~am, Ja V 58, 24* (= santikaṃ, ct. ) = 59, 13* ; Vl 425, 3* (= santikaṃ, ct. ); Vedehassa ~ā, Vl 418, 12* ; mayhaṃ ~e, Ap 146, 25 ; Pv 263 (ll 9:16; = samīpe, Pv-a): Ja lV 337, 7 '.
